verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents its own GenAI DDQ questionnaire feature, including 'Autofill Automation for Questionnaires' and uploading previous questionnaires to a library. That implies some questionnaire ingestion, but the evidence consists only of article titles, with no detail on supported formats or export. Missing for 10: documented import of SIG/CAIQ/spreadsheet formats, portal-based questionnaire support, export back in the customer's original format, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
